name: P.L.U.T.O. Rescue of Richmond County (Pet Lovers United Together as One)
aka: P.L.U.T.O. Rescue (Pet Lovers United Together as One)
notes:
All-volunteer 501(c)(3) no-kill on Staten Island. Uses the Merry Mutts Play & Stay facility (654A Sharrotts Rd, SI 10309) plus volunteer fosters. Dogs HW-tested; cats FIV/FeLV-tested; all vetted + altered + microchipped before adoption. App reviewed -> home visit -> paperwork at the visit. Mail: PO Box 140889, Staten Island 10314. Solid SI option beyond Louie's Legacy. Phone: (no public phone; contact via FB/site) Email: (via Facebook message / site) Intake: Adopt/foster via site, Petfinder & Adoptapet Intake: Saturday adoption events Intake: application -> home visit

No-kill 501(c)(3) since 2001. Cats + dogs (strays + owner surrender), full vetting. Runs a LOW-COST SPAY/NEUTER program + supports TNR for feral cats. Phone + email confirmed on own listings. Intake: Pre-adopt form + home visit Intake: Sat adoptions 12-3 at Petco 2752 Veterans Rd W 10309 Other channel: PO Box 140889, Staten Island 10314 Other channel: contact Lisa Rooney
